name: Tengshe
introduce:
DD-720 Tengshe
A Light ST developed in collaboration with the Doll Group.
The Tengshe features a radical innovations in exterior design and armor material selection, significantly reducing the weight of the body while ensuring standard levels of protection. Its regular power system, along with the optimized energy-efficient "Flame Core," allows the Tengshe to maintain high-speed maneuverability while loading larger and heavier weapons of mass destruction. Overall, the birth of the Tengshe has completely overturned the battlefield role of traditional Light STs.

30388.name: Opportunist Mod
30388.SpecificEffects: When in combat, if this unit's HP percentage is greater than or equal to the target's, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>. If the attack is not an active attack, DMG is additionally <color=#F74848>+12%</color>. When actively attacking, if consuming greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>5</color> AP, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP, can be triggered up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

20464.name: Flame Core
20464.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a skill that costs <color=#F74848>3</color> AP or more, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>. For every <color=#F74848>1</color> additional AP consumed, this effect <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>35%</color>.
